reason: Remove only the two unused unit specializations; retain actual general suppliers; do not create artificial consumers.

changes.name: scalarTrace_finite_positive_seed
changes.removed:
/-- An actual finite positive seed in A1's regular core. -/
theorem scalarTrace_finite_positive_seed (P : SiteProfile) :
    ∃ Y : PositiveCoreInput P, Y ≤ positiveUnit P ∧
      0 < scalarInverseLimitWeight P Y ∧ scalarInverseLimitWeight P Y < ⊤ :=
  regularTrace_finite_positive_below P (scalarInverseLimitTraceData.{0} P)
    (positiveUnit P) (positiveUnit_ne_zero P)

changes.name: scalarTrace_finite_projection_exists
changes.removed:
theorem scalarTrace_finite_projection_exists (P : SiteProfile) :
    ∃ q : PositiveCoreInput P, IsStarProjection q.val ∧
      0 < scalarInverseLimitWeight P q ∧ scalarInverseLimitWeight P q < ⊤ := by
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hpos,hfin,_⟩ := scalarTrace_finite_subprojection_exists P
    (positiveUnit P) (IsStarProjection.one _) (positiveUnit_ne_zero P)
  exact ⟨q,hq,hpos,hfin⟩
